units.source_text: “我很喜欢这里的樟树林荫道，一直等待植物园重新开放。

en.t: I really like this camphor tree avenue here, and I have been waiting for the botanical garden to reopen.

units.source_text: 这些樟树都有五六十年了。

en.t: These camphor trees are all fifty or sixty years old.
We just strolled over here at our own pace.”

units.source_text: 宗助又抱歉说，“前些日子，我孩子太不懂礼貌了……”

en.t: Sosuke apologized again, saying, “The other day, my child was terribly rude...”
